author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: one diagonal airplane outline with a round nose, swept trapezoid wings with blunt tips and two small tail fins meeting in a notch; reads immediately as a plane. The rejected drawing was a chunky blob whose wings and fins merged into a cross.
omissions: The reference's slightly off-45-degree axis is drawn at exactly 45 degrees so the drawing mirrors about x + y = 48; wing tips are a little shorter than the reference so every chord stays 8 wide.
drawing_plan: SQUARE, mirror about x+y=48: fuselage between x+y=41 and x+y=55, r5 nose about (37,11); wing (29,12)-(13,6)-(6,12)-(22,19); fin (15,26)-(8,22)-(6,31); tail notch (14,34).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'plane' - diagonal fuselage, round nose, swept wings and tail fins.
